newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products gain except high sulphur barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain except high sulphur barges.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Tuesday, including gasoline, gas oil and low sulphur fuel, traders said.
Gasoline firmed $1 on prompt barges as three deals for Eurograde prompt to balance of August were heard done at $227 FOB.
Cargo market players were said to be simply looking to the barge market for a lead as September swap values jumped $6 on the back of IPE and NYMEX gains.
The naphtha physical market was little talked as swaps gained $2.
